title: Whale Watch: the dock, the kelp and the town
kaylee: Tofino looks like a real little town: painted cottages with porches and picket fences, proper fishing boats at the dock, and seaweed that looks like seaweed.

pictures.title: At the dock
pictures.caption: The fishing boats' decks no longer flicker: each is one hull now, with a wheelhouse, mast and fenders

pictures.title: The town
pictures.caption: Cottages with clapboard, porches, flower boxes, chimneys and picket fences

pictures.title: The kelp by the otters
pictures.caption: Bull kelp: a float with long ribbons trailing in the current (they looked like propellers)
